bio.text: Andrew Jones is a Republican member of the Alabama Senate for District 10; the profile lists Jones as a member of the Senate since 2018.
According to Jones's legislative profile, the profession is farmer and coffee roaster.
The profile lists a B.A. in music from Berea College and a master's in public policy from the College of William and Mary.
